_comment: HAND-WRITTEN corpus. It pins a DECISION, not any one relay's behaviour: which server-authored plans a relay may RUN, and which it must instead skip as `unsupported_plan_kind` before resolving a credential or calling the broker. THE RULE: a plan is runnable iff (a) `signed_auth` is absent or null, or its `kind` is one this relay implements, AND (b) `program` is absent or null, or every step's `kind` is one this relay implements, checked recursively through each `for_each` step's own `steps`. A missing `kind` is not a kind this relay implements. Only kinds are judged here; a step whose kind is known but whose fields are malformed is the interpreter's business, not this check's. Every relay today implements signers `qc_hmac_v1`, `ovh_v1` and steps `request`, `poll`, `for_each`, so `mystery_*` stands in for whatever the server ships next. The pre-flight is a skip, not a failure: the relay is behind the server, nothing about the card is broken, and an update fixes it.

vectors.name: flat-plan-no-signer-runs
vectors.why: The common case: a bearer-header flat plan names no signer and no program, so there is nothing a relay could be missing.

vectors.name: explicit-null-signer-and-program-run
vectors.why: The server serialises an absent signer and program as null; null must read as absent, not as an unknown kind.

vectors.name: ovh-signer-runs
vectors.why: The signer whose arrival on the server ahead of the macOS app is what this rule exists for.

vectors.name: unknown-signer-skips
vectors.why: A signer this relay has not learned. Running the plan would throw mid-entry after the credential was already resolved; the relay must skip it up front instead.

vectors.name: signer-without-kind-skips
vectors.why: A signer object with no kind names nothing this relay implements, so it cannot be signed.

vectors.name: program-of-known-steps-runs
vectors.why: Request and poll at the top level, the BigQuery shape.

vectors.name: nested-for-each-of-known-steps-runs
vectors.why: The check recurses: a for_each whose own steps are a request and a nested for_each is runnable.

vectors.name: unknown-top-level-step-skips
vectors.why: A step kind this relay has not learned, at the top level of the program.

vectors.name: unknown-step-inside-for-each-skips
vectors.why: The unknown kind is only reachable by recursing into a for_each. A check that looked at top-level kinds alone would run this plan and fail inside the loop.

vectors.name: step-without-kind-skips
vectors.why: A step with no kind names nothing this relay implements.

vectors.name: known-program-with-unknown-signer-skips
vectors.why: Both halves are judged: a runnable program does not excuse a signer this relay cannot apply.
